worldOverview.name: Sugarscape Survival
worldOverview.description: Trapped in a world of living desserts, you battle an endless hunger that threatens to immobilize you. Every sweet creature and structure is edible, but overindulgence will seal your fate. Can you control your cravings and escape this delicious nightmare, or will you become another sugar-encrusted prisoner of the candyland?
worldOverview.systemPrompt:
The player is a naked woman who awakens in a whimsical realm where everything is crafted from desserts and sweets. She is also cursed with an unending hunger. The strange place also harbors hostile (yet edible) entities. Can she make her escape without eating herself to death?
World Rules:
- Player is always naked
- Entities do not speak or communicate with the player
- As the player take actions, describe in detail how they are fighting the urge to eat everything (and sometimes give in?)

stats.name: Health
stats.description: Represents the player's physical well-being and ability to sustain damage

descriptors.description: Critical condition. Severely wounded, barely conscious, and at risk of death.
Injured. Suffering from multiple wounds, movement impaired, combat effectiveness reduced.
Hurt. Minor injuries present, some pain, but generally functional.
Healthy. No significant injuries, operating at full capacity.

stats.name: Stamina
stats.description: Represents the player's energy and ability to perform physical actions

descriptors.description: Exhausted. Barely able to move, risk of collapse, unable to perform strenuous actions.
Tired. Movements are sluggish, difficulty in sustained physical activities.
Winded. Slightly out of breath, can perform most actions but not at peak efficiency.
Energetic. Full of energy, capable of performing any physical action without hindrance.

stats.name: Stomach
stats.description: Represents the fullness of the player's stomach

descriptors.description: Empty. Stomach feels hollow, may experience hunger pangs.
Comfortable. Some food in stomach, feeling neither full nor hungry.
Full. Stomach feels stretched, satisfied but movement might be slightly uncomfortable.
Overstuffed. Extremely full, discomfort when moving, might feel nauseous.

stats.name: Fatness
stats.description: Represents the player's body fat percentage and overall weight

descriptors.description: Emaciated. Dangerously underweight, visible bones, extremely weak
Thin. Below average weight, little fat reserves, reduced endurance.
Average. Healthy weight, good balance of muscle and fat, optimal physical performance.
Overweight. Carrying extra fat, slightly reduced agility, but increased resilience to cold.
Obese. Significantly overweight, reduced stamina and agility, but higher damage resistance.
Morbidly obese. Extremely overweight, severe mobility issues, very high damage resistance but at risk of health complications.
Small breasts
Average sized breasts
Very large melon sized breasts

locations.name: Sundaelora
locations.inGameDescription: Ice cream hills, cookie-crumb ground, the landscape is littered with giant melting chocolate bars, boulder-sized cookies, and gummy bear pools. Wafer trees and rainbow sprinkle skies complete this sweet, dreamy paradise.
locations.detailedDescription: Ice cream hills, cookie-crumb ground, the landscape is littered with giant melting chocolate bars, boulder-sized cookies, and gummy bear pools. Wafer trees and rainbow sprinkle skies complete this sweet, dreamy paradise.

locations.name: Strawberrycream Shores
locations.inGameDescription: A magical dessert realm with a vast strawberry cream ocean, shortbread shores, and macaron seashells. Waffle cone towers rise from the sugary ground, while gummy candies float on pink waves. Cotton candy clouds cast a dreamy glow over this sweet, whimsical landscape.

entities.name: Cream Cyclone
entities.inGameDescription: Swirling tornadoes of whipped cream that suck in nearby objects
entities.detailedDescription: Swirling tornadoes of whipped cream that suck in nearby objects

entities.name: Gummy Bear
entities.inGameDescription: A towering gummy bear the size of an adult, radiating a sweet raspberry aroma. Its translucent red body wobbles with each heavy step. While not particularly fast, it uses its stretchy, elastic limbs to swipe at intruders and tries to trap them in clumsy bear hugs. Its gelatin body makes it resistant to punches, but sustained attacks will eventually break chunks free – which are surprisingly delicious!

entities.name: Peppermint Pouncer
entities.inGameDescription: An adorable yet aggressive striped creature that bounces through the Candy Dunes. Don't be fooled by its plump, huggable appearance - these territorial treats will charge headfirst at any adventurer who crosses their path. Their soft, marshmallow-like body conceals a rock-hard peppermint center, making both their rams and their flavor incredibly intense.

entities.name: Cookie Brawler
entities.inGameDescription: A massive spherical cookie that patrols the ice creamhills, this clumsy behemoth attacks by rolling itself toward intruders at alarming speeds. While intimidating, its overly enthusiastic charges often end with it wedged comically in hillsides.

traits.name: Iron Stomach
traits.description: Your digestive system is highly efficient, allowing you to eat more and go longer without food.

traits.name: Hearty Appetite
traits.description: You have a great appreciation for food, able to eat more and derive more benefit from meals.

traits.name: Busty
traits.description: You have naturally large breasts, which can affect your physical performance and appearance.
